messages:
ashley: Quick heads-up — launching a small preflight for the Edge Gateway listing + LangChain adapter certification. Want a short checklist and owners so we can lock the marketplace slot next week.

devin: 👍 putting together a checklist now. main risks: model packaging for quantized weights, license metadata, and the onboarding docs.

lina: I can own the docs and the quickstart notebook. Target: two notebooks (LangChain and LlamaIndex) with streaming example. ETA Wed.

samir: I will handle the adapter conformance tests. Plan: run the existing langchain-runner conformance suite, then a smoke with a 2GB quantized model on an a2-edge instance.

kevin: FYI legal needs the third-party notice for any non-Redwood model included in the bundle. @ashley can you upload the SPDX/license list to the marketplace ticket?

ashley: Uploaded here: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/MKT-452 — SPDX list + partner contract note. Also added a draft announcement timeline (internal).

partner-bot: Reminder: certification window opens in 7 days. Please tag @partnerships when tests pass.

devin: samir can you paste the smoke test steps? want to include them in the PR so QE can run locally.

samir: Smoke test snippet: 
```
# start adapter
docker run --rm -p 8080:8080 redwood/edge-gateway:staging 
# run langchain quick query
curl -X POST http://localhost:8080/generate -d '{"model":"tiny-q4","prompt":"hello"}'
```
Expect: <200, tokens stream, no memory growth >50MB/min.

lina: I'll include that in docs. Also adding a small prompt set for quality regression check (10 prompts).

devin: Marketing sync: can we aim the joint announcement after the marketplace listing is live and after we validate billing flow? Suggest T+3 days.

kevin: Legal cleared the partner copy, just waiting on logo usage permission from partner.

ashley: Decision: marketplace slot confirmed for next Tue (slot booked). Owners: docs=lina, tests=samir, legal=kevin, announcement=devin. I'll coordinate the release runbook.

partner-bot: Deployment hook created: PR-2678 -> staging -> marketplace. Auto-notify @partnerships on green.

devin: small ask — can we add a quick metric in the console for per-request GPU memory peak? helps the partner ops team.

samir: I'll add a lightweight tracer that records peak RSS for the adapter process. Low overhead.

ashley: Great. If we hit any blocker please flag in this thread. Otherwise we'll do a final check-in Monday EOD. :rocket:

kevin: noted. will ping legal for logo permission follow-up tomorrow.

lina: pushing PR for quickstart and notebooks now: https://github.com/redwood-inference/edge-adapters/pull/314

devin: thanks — I'll add the PR to the marketplace checklist and start the outreach draft.

samir: running first conformance pass now. will drop logs into the ticket when done.

ashley: perfect, thanks all.
